description: Source code for DetectAmbiguousSelfJoin object in Apache Spark, which detects ambiguous self-joins in logical plans to prevent confusing query results.

classes.name: ColumnReference
classes.description: Case class representing a dataset column reference with dataset ID, column position, and expression ID.

methods.name: isColumnReference
methods.description: Checks if an AttributeReference has special metadata indicating a dataset column reference.

methods.name: toColumnReference
methods.description: Converts an AttributeReference with special metadata into a ColumnReference object.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main rule application method that detects ambiguous self-joins in a logical plan.

methods.name: stripColumnReferenceMetadataInPlan
methods.description: Removes dataset-related metadata from AttributeReferences in a logical plan.

methods.name: stripColumnReferenceMetadata
methods.description: Removes dataset ID and column position metadata from a specific AttributeReference.
